title: Artificial Intelligence and Predictive Data Analytics to Enhance Risk Assessment and Credit Scoring Mechanisms in Retail Banking
tldr: AI-driven framework using variational Bayesian inference with spatio-temporal attention mechanisms for dynamic creditworthiness scoring in retail banking.
problem_and_motivation: Traditional credit scoring systems rely on simplified heuristics and linear models that cannot capture complex nonlinear interactions among factors influencing borrower behavior.
approach: Proposes unified theoretical framework integrating heterogeneous data sources from financial ratios to behavioral indicators.
Develops variational Bayesian inference combined with spatio-temporal attention mechanisms for dynamic credit scores.
Autoencoder networks for feature embedding and dimensionality reduction.
Calibrates loss functions to balance type I and type II error costs under regulatory constraints.
Addresses model validation including back-testing over stressed economic scenarios.
findings: AI and ML methodologies significantly improve risk discrimination power over traditional linear models.
Variational Bayesian inference enables dynamic creditworthiness scores that evolve with borrower behavior.
Operational deployment considerations include scalable microservice architectures and continuous learning pipelines.
